verdict.rationale: Shopify's docs directly claim its one-click checkout (Shop Pay) plus accepted wallets/cards ('Accept cards, wallets, installments, and crypto—from day one') and the checkout is described as the 'world's highest-converting, customizable, one-click checkout' powering 12% of US ecommerce, indicating built-in accelerated checkout support without re-entering buyer details. Runtime probes also confirm cart/checkout flows advertise payment handlers like shopify.card, shop_pay, and gpay. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation naming Apple Pay/PayPal/Google Pay individually as supported wallets and independent hands-on confirmation of a true one-click cross-wallet experience.
